name: Reaction-Diffusion
desc: A bold Gray-Scott Turing pattern that grows and divides forever, deep-ground coral veins and mitotic spots blazing in saturated teal, magenta and gold through a high-contrast palette LUT, with bone, ironbow-thermal, moss and a mono ink-maze contour mode.

energy.doc: contrast / gain of the field-to-color mapping (crest brightness)

scale.doc: display zoom — magnify a sub-region of the pattern

hue.doc: rotates the whole palette LUT (0 = the anchored teal/magenta/gold)

feed.doc: Gray-Scott feed rate (grow act wanders around it)

kill.doc: Gray-Scott kill rate (grow act wanders around it)

style.doc: color mapping: coral = vivid teal/magenta/gold on deep ground (default) / bone = warm ivory tonal mass on slate / thermal = ironbow heat ramp / moss = organic forest greens / ink-maze = mono contour iso-lines (non-representational)

act.doc: multi-minute regime: grow = coral branching wander / mitosis = locked dividing spots / maze = labyrinthine channels

seed.doc: initial seed-blob layout (rebuilds field on change)

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg)
